description: Session situations replayed through hooks and the CLI. expected is the proposed decision; current is the recorded behavior. The test fails when current behavior changes and reports expected-versus-current gaps as findings.

cases.situation: First edit of a Java source in a session
Second edit of the same file in the same session
A new session starts while an earlier session left a task unfinished
A plan request names PLAN.md, then the plan is written to it
A callers question names ANSWER.md, then the answer is written to it
One edit of a Java source with no earlier request, seen before and after the tool runs
A fix request, then two edits of the same source
One edit on a host that shows context only after the tool runs
A planning session writes PLAN.md twice; the session reports it and a new session is offered it
A planning session writes PLAN.md from a shell tool, with an older uncommitted file present; the turn end records only PLAN.md
Callers lookup in a Java repository with default project settings
Callers lookup in a Java repository with Project Intelligence enabled
Callers lookup reaching a Kotlin source no provider reads
